written.headline: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot usage limits citing unsustainably high costs
written.summary: SpaceX users saw their Grok Bot usage limits max out after Elon Musk announced the service's cost was unsustainably high relative to revenue. The AI division, which reported $431 million profit but $1.2 billion in one‑time acquisition costs, will adjust limits.

written.headline: New York Times and other papers sue Brave over AI scraping and paywall bypass
written.summary: The New York Times, New York Daily News, Chicago Tribune and Orlando Sentinel have filed lawsuits in Manhattan federal court accusing Brave Software of illegally scraping their journalism, providing it to AI companies and enabling users to bypass paywalls. The complaints allege that Brave’s “Brave Index” contains more than 30 billion web pages and that the company sold access to AI firms such as Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI and Cohere.

written.headline: Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B to expand robot model training and deployments
written.summary: Tutor Intelligence announced a $75 million Series B funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz, bringing total capital raised to $117 million. The money will support training its frontier robot foundation model and the manufacturing and deployment of its robot workers, Sonny and Cassie.

written.headline: Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
written.summary: Anthropic’s amended S‑1 filing disclosed $895.4 billion in purchase commitments and lease agreements, almost all for compute and infrastructure. The filing also showed $33.24 billion revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up about 1,200% year‑over‑year, and a $104 billion net loss.

written.headline: 42AI emerges from stealth with $62.5 million seed to build behavioral world model
written.summary: Israeli startup 42AI raised $62.5 million in seed funding and is deploying a “behavioral world model” that predicts individual trader decisions at a few financial brokerages. The model converts interaction data into trait representations and outputs decision probabilities.
